title: Privacy Policy
intro: Boxium (hereinafter referred to as 'the Platform' or 'we') values the protection of your privacy. This Privacy Policy (hereinafter referred to as 'this Policy') explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect the personal data you provide when using our services. Please read this Policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

section1.title: 1. Collection of Personal Data
section1.p1: When you use the Platform's services, we may collect the following types of personal data:

subsection1.title: 1.1 Data You Voluntarily Provide
subsection1.p1: When you register an account, use certain features, or contact us, you may voluntarily provide the following data:
items: Personal preference settings (such as saved cards, wishlist, etc.)
Seller information (such as Stripe Connect account, item descriptions, etc.)
Transaction-related information (such as delivery address, order records, etc.)
Other information you enter when using Platform features

subsection2.title: 1.2 Automatically Collected Data
subsection2.p1: When you visit or use the Platform, we automatically collect certain technical information, including:
items: Pages visited and feature usage records
Information collected by cookies and similar technologies

section2.title: 2. Purposes of Using Personal Data
section2.p1: We collect your personal data primarily for the following purposes:

purposes.title: Service Provision:
purposes.desc: To provide you with core services including card research, price lookup, market trend analysis, and marketplace transactions

purposes.title: Transaction Processing:
purposes.desc: To process transactions, payments, refunds, and dispute resolution between buyers and sellers

purposes.title: Service Improvement:
purposes.desc: To analyze user behavior and preferences to optimize Platform features and user experience

purposes.title: Personalized Experience:
purposes.desc: To provide customized content and recommendations based on your preferences

purposes.title: Notifications and Communication:
purposes.desc: To send you order updates, transaction notifications, service updates, or other important notices

purposes.title: Security Maintenance:
purposes.desc: To detect, prevent, and handle fraud, abuse, or other illegal activities

purposes.title: Legal Compliance:
purposes.desc: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, or court orders

section3.title: 3. Disclosure and Sharing of Personal Data
section3.p1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may disclose or share your personal data in the following circumstances:

scenarios.title: Service Providers:
scenarios.desc: We may share your data with third-party service providers who assist us in providing services (such as cloud storage services, data analytics tools, etc.). These service providers may only use your data within the scope of providing services and are subject to confidentiality obligations

scenarios.title: Legal Requirements:
scenarios.desc: When required by law, regulation, court order, or government authority, we may need to disclose your data

scenarios.title: Protection of Rights:
scenarios.desc: To protect the rights, property, or safety of the Platform, users, or the public, we may need to disclose your data

scenarios.title: Business Transfer:
scenarios.desc: If the Platform undergoes a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your personal data may be transferred as part of the business assets

scenarios.title: Payment Service Providers:
scenarios.desc: We use Stripe to process payments. Related payment information will be handled in accordance with Stripe's privacy policy. We do not store complete credit card information

section4.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
section4.p1: The Platform uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that record your preference settings, login status, and usage behavior.
section4.p2: The types of cookies we use include:

types.title: Essential Cookies:
types.desc: These cookies are necessary for the basic functioning of the Platform, such as maintaining your login status

types.title: Functional Cookies:
types.desc: These cookies remember your preference settings to provide a more personalized experience

types.title: Analytical Cookies:
types.desc: These cookies help us understand how users use the Platform so we can improve our services

section4.p3: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect some features of the Platform.

section5.title: 5. Data Security
section5.p1: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction. These measures include but are not limited to:
measures: Using encryption technology to protect data transmission
Restricting employee and service provider access to personal data
Regularly reviewing and updating security measures
section5.p2: However, please note that no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure. Although we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention Period
section6.p1: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected. When your data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it. Specific retention periods depend on the type of data and purpose of use, for example:
periods: Account data: retained during the validity of your account and for a reasonable period after account deletion
Usage records: typically retained for 12 to 24 months
Legally required data: retained in accordance with legally mandated periods

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
section7.p1: Under applicable personal data protection laws, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

rights.title: Right of Access:
rights.desc: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you

rights.title: Right of Rectification:
rights.desc: If your personal data is inaccurate or incomplete, you have the right to request correction

rights.title: Right of Erasure:
rights.desc: In certain circumstances, you have the right to request deletion of your personal data

rights.title: Right to Restrict Processing:
rights.desc: In certain circumstances, you have the right to request that we restrict our processing of your personal data

rights.title: Right to Data Portability:
rights.desc: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format

rights.title: Right to Object:
rights.desc: You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests

section7.p2: If you wish to exercise the above rights, please contact us through the contact information below. We will respond to your request within a reasonable timeframe.

section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
section8.p1: The Platform's services are intended for the general public. We do not intentionally collect personal data from children under the age of 13. If you are a parent or guardian and discover that your child has provided us with personal data without your consent, please contact us and we will delete the relevant data as soon as possible.

section9.title: 9. Cross-Border Data Transfers
section9.p1: Your personal data may be transferred to and processed or stored in locations outside your country or region. We will ensure that such data transfers comply with applicable personal data protection laws and that appropriate protective measures are in place.

section10.title: 10. Policy Amendments
section10.p1: We may amend this Privacy Policy from time to time. Amended policies will be published on this page with the last updated date noted. If the amendments are significant, we will notify you by email or platform notification. We recommend that you regularly review this page to stay informed of the latest Privacy Policy.

section11.title: 11. Contact Us
section11.p1: If you have any questions, comments, or wish to exercise your personal data rights regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
